identity_freeze: Before first live attempt, supervisor atomically freezes one exact provider, model, model version, client version, decoding configuration and SHA-256, pi-subagents 0.34.0 version, integer micro-USD-per-million-token pricing, three-PR integer micro-USD budget approval, and custom-agent config hash in the authenticated execution manifest.
fresh_context: Review A and adjudication use a fresh custom agent per PR with inheritProjectContext false. Review B is independently written by the parent supervisor inside one exact, isolated supervisor-session interval before Review A escrow is opened.
review_b_measurement: Each parent Review B interval has unique start/end event and message IDs. Exact session usage and tool events in the interval provide tokens/tool calls; exact interval bytes are hashed; wall, RSS, disk, bytes, retries/failure, and integer cost use telemetry-contract-v1. No unrelated work may occur inside the interval.
training_or_memory_rule: Do not solicit prior labels or benchmark knowledge; accidental recognition is an append-only custody incident, produces no schema artifact, and is no_go.
retry_rule: At most one fresh-context retry for transport, malformed JSON, or tool failure; record every attempt; never retry for a preferred semantic answer.
